patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Three distinct lows visible: left shoulder near 64500, head near 62500, right shoulder near 64000-64500. Neckline resistance around 65500-66000. Price recently spiked above neckline to ~66000 and is retesting around 65442.

patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Prior bearish market structure (lower highs and lower lows from 67000 to 62500) was broken by strong rally above swing highs near 65500-66000, indicating a shift to bullish order flow.

patterns_found.name: Bullish Flag
patterns_found.evidence: Sharp upward impulse from ~64000 to ~66000 followed by tight downward-sloping consolidation around 65500-65800, consistent with a bullish flag formation.
